description:
## What

The pivot. Move all compaction triggering and orchestration out of `OctoPi.Agent.Loop` into `OctoPi.Coder.Loop`. Mirrors upstream `AgentSession.compact()` (manual, line 1605) and `_checkCompaction` (auto, line 578 / line 1027).

Three trigger points, all in Coder:

1. **Manual** (`Coder.compact/2`):
   - `Agent.abort(agent_pid)` (no-op if idle).
   - Run prep + extension `:session_before_compact` hooks + summarization.
   - Persist via `SessionStore.append_entry` (Compaction entry).
   - `Agent.set_messages(agent_pid, [summary, ...kept_tail])`.
   - Return `compact_result()` synchronously to original caller.

2. **Auto, post-turn**:
   - Coder.Loop already subscribes to `MessageEnd` / `AgentEnd` events.
   - In that handler, check threshold (`SessionManager.context_tokens` / SettingsManager).
   - If triggered, run the same flow as manual (no abort needed — agent is already idle).

3. **Auto, pre-prompt** (in `:agent_prompt` handler):
   - Before forwarding to `OctoPi.Agent.prompt`, check threshold.
   - If triggered, run compact first, then forward.

Delete from Agent:

- `OctoPi.Agent.Event.CompactionRequested`, `OctoPi.Agent.Event.CompactionEnd` (the latter is fully replaced by Coder-emitted `:session_compact` extension events; verify before deleting).
- `Agent.compact/2`, `Agent.compaction_response/3`, the corresponding Loop GenServer handles.
- `Agent.Loop.State.auto_compact_reserve_tokens` and the threshold-check logic (`find_last_successful_context_tokens`, etc.).
- Any Turn FSM transitions that involve compaction.

Delete from Coder.Loop:

- `pending_compact_from` (added in opi-qy9 to defer-reply through the round-trip).
- `:compact_resolved` info handler.
- `handle_info({:CompactionRequested, …})` and the spawned-task plumbing (`spawn_compact_and_finish`, `spawn_finish_compaction`, `finish_compaction`'s `compaction_response` call).

The reply contract becomes synchronous: `Coder.compact/2` blocks the caller (it's a `GenServer.call(:infinity)` already) until the work is done, returns `compact_result()`. No deferral needed.

## Why

The defer-reply machinery from opi-qy9 was the right answer for "Coder calls Agent, Agent eventually calls back via event." Once Coder is the one running the compaction — synchronously, in its own process — the original `from` is the same caller; just `{:reply, result, state}` and done.

The Agent kernel becomes upstream-shaped: zero references to compact / threshold / overflow. It just runs turns on whatever `loop.messages` happens to contain.

## Files

- `apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/loop.ex` — bulk delete: compaction handles, Turn transitions, threshold logic, state fields.
- `apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent.ex` — drop `compact/2`, `compaction_response/3`.
- `apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/event.ex` — drop `CompactionRequested`, `CompactionEnd`.
- `apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/turn.ex` (or wherever Turn FSM lives) — drop compaction states.
- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/loop.ex` — manual compact rewritten to synchronous; auto-compact in MessageEnd / AgentEnd handlers; pre-prompt check in `:agent_prompt`.

## Out of scope

- Branch summary / navigation (opi-y0a.4 — same pattern, separate ticket).
- Dropping `:path` (opi-y0a.5).

## Done when

- `git grep -i "compact\\|CompactionRequested\\|compaction_response" apps/octo_pi_agent/lib` returns empty (or only docstring crumbs).
- All three Coder trigger points work; existing `Coder.compact/2` callers see the same return shape (`compact_result()`).
- Tests asserting on `CompactionRequested` events from Agent migrate to subscribing to Coder's `:session_compact` events (or asserting on resulting `Agent.loop.messages` shape).
- A test verifies a session compacted via Coder produces the same JSONL as one compacted via the old round-trip (byte-stable parity).
title: Coder owns compaction trigger and run; Agent kernel goes passive
